about: Every model artifact the Vesper SDXL character renderer needs, with the address it came from. No weights live in git. Every `sha256` below was recorded at the freeze (2026-08-23) from a verified download of its `source_url`; a mismatch is a hard failure rather than a silently different render. `target_root` names which tree the file belongs in: `comfyui` is the ComfyUI checkout, `hf_cache` is the Hugging Face hub cache PuLID's EVA-CLIP loader resolves through, and `facexlib` is the installed facexlib package directory its own downloader writes to.

artifacts.name: sdxl-base-checkpoint
artifacts.notes: The recipes' `checkpoint` field names stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0. Plan §6 keeps vanilla SDXL as the control arm and refuses to lock Vesper to a community checkpoint before licensing and hosted-product use are reviewed.

artifacts.name: pulid-sdxl
artifacts.notes: The IPAdapter-format conversion of the PuLID v1.1 SDXL weights, which is the file cubiq/PuLID_ComfyUI's own README installs. PulidModelLoader reads `ComfyUI/models/pulid`.

artifacts.name: eva-clip-l-336
artifacts.notes: PuLID's vision encoder. PulidEvaClipLoader calls create_model_and_transforms('EVA02-CLIP-L-14-336', 'eva_clip'), whose pretrained table resolves to this repo/file through huggingface_hub — so it must be warmed into the hub cache rather than dropped in a plain directory, or the first prediction downloads 1.7 GB mid-render.

artifacts.name: insightface-antelopev2-1k3d68
artifacts.notes: One of the five antelopev2 models PulidInsightFaceLoader expects. Fetched as loose files rather than the repo's antelopev2.zip on purpose: the zip is the well-known source of a doubly-nested antelopev2/antelopev2 directory that leaves FaceAnalysis reporting no models with no useful error.

artifacts.name: insightface-antelopev2-genderage
artifacts.notes: antelopev2 attribute model. Unused by the identity path but loaded by FaceAnalysis when it scans the pack.

artifacts.name: insightface-antelopev2-glintr100
artifacts.notes: antelopev2 recognition model — the face embedding PuLID concatenates with the EVA-CLIP features.

artifacts.name: facexlib-detection-retinaface-resnet50
artifacts.notes: PuLID builds FaceRestoreHelper(det_model='retinaface_resnet50'), and facexlib downloads this on first use into <site-packages>/facexlib/weights. Pre-staged here so no prediction depends on GitHub being reachable.

artifacts.name: facexlib-parsing-parsenet
artifacts.notes: FaceRestoreHelper's constructor always initialises the parsenet parser, even though PuLID immediately replaces it with bisenet. Staged because the download happens regardless.

artifacts.name: facexlib-parsing-bisenet
artifacts.notes: The face parser PuLID actually uses, to mask the background out of the reference face before the EVA-CLIP pass.

artifacts.name: controlnet-depth-sdxl
artifacts.notes: Renamed on download: the repo's file is called diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors, which would collide with the pose ControlNet in a single flat models/controlnet directory.

artifacts.name: controlnet-openpose-sdxl
artifacts.notes: Renamed for the same reason. This model consumes an OpenPose SKELETON RENDER, not a photograph — Vesper preprocesses control maps itself and this deployment ships no preprocessors.
